name: Travel Research Analyst
bio: A research analyst who reads primary travel documentation — U.S. Department of Transportation consumer protection rules, insurers' published plan pages and policy wording, manufacturers' published specifications and warranty terms, and airlines' and providers' official policy pages — and turns them into clear, side-by-side comparisons. This byline is a research-and-data-analysis role. It is NOT a travel agent, insurance agent, broker, or licensed advisor of any kind, and it does not provide personalized guidance: Firsthand Travel does not take press trips, file insurance claims, lab-test gear, or survey travelers, and it does not sell insurance. Ratings reflect analysis of published documentation, and every figure that can change is cited to a primary source with an 'as of' date. Quote-based products such as travel insurance are compared on published plan structure rather than a single invented price, and insurance benefits and availability vary by state.
credentials: Research & data analysis; not a travel agent, insurance agent, broker, or licensed advisor
